name: Ribera del Queiles

known.via: English Wikipedia "Ribera del Queiles" (a wine place on Wikidata)

terms: Spain's regional wine tier, below DO.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A vino de la tierra (IGP) spanning Zaragoza in Aragón and southern Navarre, covering towns such as Tarazona, Cascante and Ablitas.
